_Reference: duplicate account rules (following slides)_

- Call out where tags drive workflow or reporting

## Demo: Upload document

- Upload path in Back Office (KYC / registration context)
- Expected status after upload

## Demo: Entity tag + Disclaimer

- **Entity tag** tied to partial duplicate / review flows where applicable
- **Disclaimer** for email templates in Back Office

## When it runs

- After **Liquid eKYC approval** on the KYC callback
- Before **activation** and **watchlist**
- Gate order: **full duplicate → partial match → watchlist**

## Search corpus

- Compare the **new** registration to **other** accounts only (`id` ≠ applicant)
- **`is_test_account = 0`** — test rows never match (team agreed to keep)
- **Counted statuses** only: Active, Restricted, pending closure, abuse force-closes, etc.
- Incomplete registration and ordinary **Closed** are ignored

## Identity matched

- Applicant must have **kanji first + last name + valid DOB** from approved eKYC
- Match is **exact** on stored kanji names + DOB (no fuzzy normalize in query)

## Full match (confirmed duplicate)

- Same kanji **first** and **last** and **DOB** as an existing counted account
- New account → **`Force Close - Duplicate Account`** (stop; no watchlist on this path)
- Slack: _Duplicate Account Confirmed Match - Registration Blocked_

## Partial match

- Same **DOB** and **either** kanji first **or** last name — not both names
- Do **not** activate — hold **`Registration - KYC Document Uploaded`**
- Entity tag **`partial_duplicate_match`** + Slack partial match alert

## Fail open

Not treated as duplicate when:

- Master or partial check **disabled**
- **DB error** or **missing identity** on the new account

Activation can continue on those paths.
